results.title: Childhood in Art
results.original_title: Die Entdeckung der Kindheit in der Kunst
results.overview: How have the changing views on children been reflected in their representation in art? From Baby Jesus to the first photographic portraits, an exploration of six centuries of art history through the prism of childhood.

results.title: Pellegrinis: A Melbourne Legacy
results.overview: Pellegrini's Espresso Bar is a testament to the enduring power of community, tradition, and love. This documentary explores the cafe's rich history, its cultural impact, and the profound legacy of its beloved figure, Sisto Malaspina.

results.title: The Golden Girls: 40 Years of Laughter and Friendship - A Special Edition of 20/20
results.original_title: The Golden Girls: 40 Years of Laughter and Friendship - A Special Edition of 20/20
results.overview: The special celebrates the 40th anniversary of the beloved sitcom and features interviews with the series creator Susan Harris, executive producer Tony Thomas, original writers, and superfans like Kelly Ripa, Sheryl Lee Ralph, and Mario Lopez. It explores the show's enduring appeal and lasting influence on pop culture.

results.title: A Cool Fish 2
results.overview: Sanjin, the little brother of Yiwu-based businessman Chen, ventures to Southeast Asia to expand his business and prove his mettle. Just as he strikes a deal with a television station, his business is hit by a global recession and a terrorist attack. Will Sanjin choose to be devoured by darkness, or will he be reborn from the ashes?

results.title: I Am Night at Noonday
results.original_title: Je suis la nuit en plein midi
results.overview: Don Quixote is resurrected in Marseille and sets out to fight fences, gates, private property rights and general segregation with his faithful squire, an ex-criminal pizza delivery man on a scooter.

results.title: Welcome Home Baby
results.overview: Judith works as an emergency doctor in Berlin. When she inherits a house in Austria from the family who gave her away as a child, her quest to solve the mystery of her origins turns into a nightmarish journey into the past and the dark places of her soul.

results.title: Chuck Billy and The Marvelous Guava Tree
results.original_title: Chico Bento e a Goiabeira Maraviosa
results.overview: Chuck Billy has spent his life picking guavas from Jed’s guava tree. But now that Dr. Agripino is going to build a road that will take down the tree, Chuck and his friends are going to do everything they can to stop it.

results.title: Big Trouble on Billycock Hill
results.overview: In this adventure, the Five work together to discover the truth behind a mysterious plane crash. When a Spitfire crashes near Kirrin Cottage, the Five must work together to save the injured pilot and find out the truth of what happened to him, before his enemies strike again.

results.title: Patah Hati Yang Kupilih
results.overview: Deeply in love but separated by an unbridgeable divide, a young couple must navigate conflicting family blessings and deep-seated differences to discover if their relationship can truly survive.

results.title: 366 Days
results.overview: In 2003, Okinawan high schooler Miu gets interested in Minato-senpai, who has just lost his both parents. She cheers him up by exchaning MiniDisk mix tapes with him. They start a long-distance relationship when Minato graduates and moves to Tokyo, and Miu eventually follows him to Tokyo for college. Some years later, while Miu is struggling with her job hunting, Minato suddenly breaks up with her, and she returns to Okinawa. 15 years later in 2024, Miu is married to her childhood friend Ryusei, and is now terminally ill. Her daughter Himari is sent to Tokyo to deliver a message on a MiniDisk to the man her mother loved.

results.title: Rave On
results.overview: A deep dive into Berlin’s club scene, following a musician over one night in a legendary techno club, which turns into a rave odyssey.

results.title: Robert Schumann: Paradise and the Peri  @ Hamburg Opera House
results.original_title: Robert Schumann: Paradise and the Peri Hamburg Opera House
results.overview: The inaugural season of Tobias Kratzer and Omer Meir Wellber's partnership at the Hamburg State Opera kicks off. The director and conductor present Schumann's rarely performed oratorio Paradise and the Peri. The Peri's quest for redemption, brilliantly interpreted by Vera-Lotte Boecker, illustrates many of today's issues, such as the need for empathy in a world shaken by crises.

results.title: Generation
results.overview: Sofia left her hometown of Kramatorsk, went through a difficult process of adapting to a new place, and dreams of becoming an actress. Bozhena, fleeing the war, found refuge in Truskavets, where she became the voice of children who, like her, had lost their homes. Marko and Maria live in Kryvyi Rih under constant shelling, but they continue to fight: the boy is learning to accept his history through creativity, and the girl is actively involved in community activities and building her future in Ukraine. Anna from Kharkiv dreams of becoming an architect and rebuilding her hometown. Veronika, who survived the occupation of Chernihiv, is healing through equestrian sports, and Valeria, whose parents took her to Germany, is still looking for an answer — whether to return or build a future abroad.

results.title: Estatuas de noche
results.overview: Alessandro, a young, idealistic, and romantic film director, crosses paths with Emma, a perfectionist theatre actress whose dream is to perform on stages across Europe. Their fleeting encounter, portrayed through a non-conventional structure reminiscent of *Bohemian Lights*, reveals that love appears when and where we least expect it.  We accompany the protagonists on a journey through a timeless Madrid, filled with colorful characters such as: a megalomaniacal and jealous actor named The Interesting Actor; an obscene film producer called Stefano Clemente; and a priest and a nun searching for anisette. These almost phantasmagorical figures compel the two young protagonists to question their ways of believing and loving.

results.title: Haunted Henry
results.overview: A reluctant cleaner's night is turned upside down when she breaks the rules.

results.title: Self-Sown
results.overview: Nikola spends the summer caught between the violence of the streets and the fragility of his broken home, where he must parent his own mother. He struggles to find a place where he does not feel completely alone.

results.title: The Happiest Story on Earth: 70 Years of Disneyland
results.original_title: The Happiest Story on Earth: 70 Years of Disneyland
results.overview: Commemorate seven decades of the magic, joy and innovation of one of the most beloved theme parks in the world.

results.title: Peleliu: Guernica of Paradise
results.original_title: ペリリュー －楽園のゲルニカ－
results.overview: In 1944 on Peleliu, Tamaru writes fake heroic tales of Japanese soldiers' deaths to families. In the hell of bombs, hunger, thirst and disease, he bonds with Yoshiki. Together they cling to life in this atrocious war of attrition. Only 34 survive. What do these two young men witness in the madness?
